title: 美国房贷利率升至7.5% 住宅成交连续第六周走弱
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's not just mortgage rates, right? That's going to impact the residential side and it's going to impact borrowing for commercial, but it's just rates in general, right?
segments.zh: 不只是房贷利率，对吧？这会影响住宅市场，也会影响商业借贷，但归根结底是整体利率的问题，对吧？

segments.en: The 10-year yield at 5-3 or wherever it is today that makes cap rates go higher, which brings real estate values lower, makes it harder to borrow. It makes stocks that have a big dividend component
segments.zh: 10年期收益率在5.3左右或今天的水平，推高了资本化率，压低了地产估值，让借贷更难。也让那些股息占比较高的权益资产
